subject: general
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) He inserted the tray into the oven and set the timer.
(2) He served the roasted chicken with a side of vegetables.
(3) He preheated the oven to the required temperature.
(4) He placed the marinated chicken into a baking tray.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sequence of arranging the sentences follows logical progression in the steps of preparing roasted chicken.
 
• **Step 1:** Preheat the oven to the required temperature. This is essential to ensure that the chicken cooks evenly.
 
• **Step 2:** Place the marinated chicken into a baking tray. This step follows preparation and ensures the chicken is ready for baking.
 
• **Step 3:** Insert the tray into the oven and set the timer. This step initiates the cooking process.
 
• **Step 4:** Serve the roasted chicken with a side of vegetables. This is the final step where the dish is plated and presented.
 
• The correct sequence is **3 - 4 - 1 - 2**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"He preheated the oven to the required temperature. He placed the marinated chicken into a baking tray. He inserted the tray into the oven and set the timer. He served the roasted chicken with a side of vegetables."</div
